title: thuja occidentalis var. plicata
intro: Thuja occidentalis var. plicata, commonly known as Eastern White Cedar, is a variety of the Eastern White Cedar tree that is native to eastern North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral effects that can help alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Eastern White Cedar include expectorant, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to relieve congestion and soothe irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include thujone, borneol, and borneol acetate, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
